احقوقفوا (form XII)
# اِحْقَوْقَفُوا (iḥqawqafū) /iħ.qaw.qa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# اِحْقَوْقِفُوا (iḥqawqifū) /iħ.qaw.qi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
